title: nmis_occurrence_endpoints.tsv
description: Row schema for nmis_occurrence_endpoints.tsv. Tab-separated, UTF-8, LF, header row required.

bioproject_accession.description: NCBI BioProject accession; the bootstrap cluster.

frozen_group.description: Frozen species group for the distance analyses: A. baumannii, Klebsiella group, P. aeruginosa, or other.

portability_class.description: Frozen five-class portability state: A chromosomal no marker, B chromosomal MGE context, C plasmid no marker, D plasmid mobilizable, E plasmid conjugative.

weight_block_balanced.description: Block-balanced weight, 1/m for an occurrence in a block of m; weights sum to 21,955.

nmdist_dist_any_bp.description: Homology-based distance carried over from NM-DIST, for the same row.

endpoint_state.description: Structural endpoint state, one of: complete_and_fully_contained (12,034); complete_in_shared_block_but_crosses_occurrence_window_boundary (716, censored); partial_or_boundary_limited (1,902); no_structurally_resolved_IS (20,488); tool failure (0).

nmis_dist_bp.description: Distance to the nearest structurally complete, fully contained IS; blank if censored.

nmis_censored.description: 1 if no such element within 10 kb.

n_complete_contained.description: Complete elements fully inside this window.

n_complete_crossing.description: Complete elements in the block that cross this occurrence's window boundary.
